cards.title: Metasploit Framework
cards.description_short: Framework for developing and executing exploits
cards.description_long: Metasploit Framework is a powerful penetration testing platform used to develop, test, and execute exploits against vulnerable systems. It includes modules for exploits, payloads, scanners, and post‑exploitation tools.

cards.title: SQLmap
cards.description_short: Automated SQL injection and database takeover tool
cards.description_long: SQLmap automates the detection and exploitation of SQL injection vulnerabilities. It can enumerate databases, tables, columns, and extract data from vulnerable web applications.

main_commands.explanation: Test a URL for SQL injection
Use a saved HTTP request file

Extract data from a specific table
Analyze SQLmap output for vulnerabilities

cards.title: BeEF
cards.description_long: BeEF (Browser Exploitation Framework) focuses on exploiting vulnerabilities in web browsers. It allows attackers to hook a browser and run commands through the browser environment.

main_commands.explanation: Inject hook script into a target browser

cards.title: SearchSploit
cards.description_short: Search exploit database from the terminal
cards.description_long: SearchSploit is a command‑line tool that allows users to search the Exploit Database locally. It helps find public exploits related to specific software or vulnerabilities.

main_commands.explanation: Search exploit for specific software version
Copy exploit code to local directory
